Two-Layer Architecture

🜲

OUTER MEMBRANE

Minimal, cheap, dumb. Just enough to terminate TLS, classify roughly, and hand off to the right cache-organism. Billed by Cloudflare.

BILLING COMPUTE
◎

INNER ORGANISM

Runs its own cycles, not 1:1 mapped to Cloudflare CPU. Semi-autonomous agents with state, patterns, and learning. Costless internal cycles.

ORGANISM COMPUTE
⬡

CACHE AS AGENT

Each cache node holds state, runs local logic, adapts responses, learns patterns. Dynamic responses from inside the cache layer.

SEMI-AUTONOMOUS
↗

GATE-NODE ROUTING

Protocol entry point. Auth, encrypt, classify, route. Decides which cache-organism handles each request. Minimal Worker overhead.

ENTRY PROTOCOL

Intelligent Caches
as AI Organisms

The key inversion: instead of cache = dumb storage and compute = Workers, we make cache = semi-autonomous agent. Each cache node is a living intelligence.

  • Holds persistent state across requests
  • Runs local classification and adaptation logic
  • Learns patterns from traffic and responses
  • Serves "dynamic" content from inside cache layer
  • Communicates with other cache organisms
  • Cloudflare sees "cache hit"; organism sees cognition
